subject: Conditional no-PO approval for Nimbus Labs pilot - evidence & SLA
messages:
From: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@nimbus-labs.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbus-labs.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary no-PO path for pilot — onboarding evidence attached

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our engineering team is excited to kick off the 6-week pilot. We're working through our finance team's requirement that a purchase order be in place before vendor onboarding. Given this is a short evaluation and invoices will be < $5k, we'd like to request a conditional no-PO path so we can start consumption while procurement completes PO setup.

What we can provide immediately:
- Filled onboarding form (attached)
- SOC 2 Type II summary (attached)
- Billing contact and card on file for first invoice

Requested conditions from our side:
- Pilot capped at $5,000 total spend
- Commitment to use Redwood's standard trial terms for the pilot

Can Redwood provision access under a temporary exception while legal/procurement finalizes the PO? If so, what evidence or guardrails do you need from our side?

Appreciate your help — happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Amelia Torres
Head of Procurement, Nimbus Labs
amelia.torres@nimbus-labs.com
+44 20 7946 0123

Attachments: Nimbus_Onboarding_Form_Filled.pdf (pdf), SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@nimbus-labs.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO path for pilot — onboarding evidence attached

Hi Amelia — thanks for the thorough packet and for uploading the onboarding form. I looped in Markus (procurement approvals) and Neha (finance ops) so we can evaluate a temporary carveout. High level: Redwood allows short, capped pilots without a formal PO in specific cases if certain controls are in place. To make this concrete, please confirm the billing contact email and the card that will be used for the first payment.

From our side, we'll need the following to approve a conditional no-PO activation:
- Completed onboarding form (received)
- SOC 2 summary (received) — our security team may follow up with a short questionnaire
- Billing method confirmation (card/ACH)
- Agreement to a spend cap and automated cutoff at $5k
- Signed provisional SLA (we can share a one-page provisional SLA that applies during the pilot)

If you agree to those guardrails I'll get a provisional approval from Procurement and Finance; procurement will still open a PO ticket in parallel and can backdate/assign invoices when the PO arrives. I'll send the provisional SLA draft and the internal checklist in a follow-up.

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. Sales Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: provisional-sla-draft.docx (docx)

Irene / Neha — forwarding Amelia's request and the attachments. My provisional stance: approve a limited no-PO activation under these explicit conditions: 
- Strict $5,000 hard cap enforced by Finance (auto-block on token consumption/invoice generation)
- Card on file or prepayment for first invoice
- Security vet: SOC2 summary acceptable; share short questionnaire link if anything gaps out
- Legal: use Redwood's one-page provisional SLA (Irene to circulate) and require a signed digital acceptance (DocuSign link)

Operational notes: we'll open a PO ticket in parallel but the pilot can start once finance confirms card/prepay. We should timebox the exception to 6 weeks and automatically require escalation if spend reaches 80% of cap.

If Neha can confirm finance-side automation (block at cap, alert at 80%), I'll sign off.

-Markus
